name: Rane Yorick
summary: At a farmhouse in Silverpine, Deathstalker Rane Yorick and her brother Quinn are cut off from the Sepulcher. Sent to scout the northern farms, they must get word to High Executor Hadrec.

sections.title: Eyes in the Woods
sections.body: Across Lordaeron, the Deathstalkers are Lady Sylvanas Windrunner's eyes, ears, and blades. Agents like Rane Yorick watch the wilds from hidden posts for threats to Forsaken rule. Rane and her brother Quinn were sent to scout northern Silverpine Forest. Feral dangers closed around them, turning their covert work into a fight to survive.

sections.title: Trapped at Ivar Patch
sections.body: At the Ivar Patch, Rane Yorick shelters in a ruined farmhouse. The ghoul Ivar the Foul has badly mauled her brother Quinn, and worgs prowl the fields between them and the Sepulcher. Rane holds to her assignment. She calls on passing Horde travelers to gather worg hearts for a healing potion, slay Ivar, and carry her report to command.

faq.answer: Rane Yorick serves with the Deathstalkers, the Forsaken order of rogues who gather intelligence and kill in secret. She is stationed at a ruined farmhouse in the Ivar Patch of Silverpine Forest.
The Deathstalkers are the Forsaken's covert rogue guild, answering to Lady Sylvanas Windrunner. They scout, spy, and carry out targeted killings across Lordaeron.

faq.q: Why is she trapped in a farmhouse?
faq.answer: Rane and her brother Quinn were sent to scout the farms of northern Silverpine Forest. At the Ivar Patch, the ghoul Ivar the Foul attacked them and badly mauled Quinn, so they took shelter in a farmhouse while he heals.
Quinn Yorick is Rane's brother and a fellow Deathstalker on the same scouting mission. Ivar the Foul badly mauled him at the Ivar Patch.

faq.q: What threats are they tracking in Silverpine?
faq.answer: Rane and Quinn were sent to scout northern Silverpine's farms for threats to Forsaken rule. They found more Scourge than expected, along with prowling worgs and the ghoul Ivar the Foul.

faq.q: Where does she report her findings?
faq.answer: Rane reports her findings to High Executor Hadrec at the Sepulcher. Hadrec oversees the Forsaken occupation of Silverpine Forest.

angles.text: As a Forsaken rogue, you see the dangerous fieldwork of the Deathstalkers in Rane Yorick's efforts to gather intelligence under enemy pressure.
As a Forsaken champion, you meet Rane as a scout guarding Silverpine Forest's frontier from hostile hands.
As a member of the Horde, you benefit from Rane's intelligence work, which helps keep Horde supply routes through Silverpine clear of worgen and local ambushes.
